jobs.description: At Miele, we work every day on products and services that stand for uncompromising quality. We do this with people who take responsibility, collaborate across borders, and strive for continuous improvement. For our Western Europe cluster, we are looking for an experienced Accounting Manager with excellent people management skills.Alongside your existing skills and experience, we're looking for engaged team players who will collaborate, innovate and use their passion to drive an exceptional customer experience at every touchpoint.If you are the best at what you do and have bold ideas and ambitions for progressing your career with Miele we want to hear from you!What you will be doing:As Accounting Manager, you are responsible for the strategic and operational oversight of financial reporting and projects across the four markets of the cluster: Belgium, Luxemburg, France and the Netherlands. You ensure the quality, reliability and compliance of financial information, while developing a forward-looking perspective for the cluster. You oversee a team of accounting experts and work closely with local teams, regional finance, the international shared service center in Poland, and the global Miele organizationKey responsibilities:Lead and develop a team of five (3 accounting officers and 2 credit controllers).Strengthen capabilities, drive performance, and foster collaboration within the team, with the International Shared Service Center and across departments.Lead the month-end and year-end closing financial processes .Ensure timely, accurate and compliant reporting of financial data (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) in accordance with Miele guidelines and local legislation.Act as the local point of contact for tax, legal and credit management related activities within the cluster.Ensure transfer pricing and intercompany compliance in line with Group policies.Act as Compliance Ambassador, safeguarding accounting integrity and financial governance.Contribute to project design, coordinate central and local stakeholders, and drive harmonization of financial processes across the cluster.Deliver pragmatic, value-driven solutions to operational needs.Why you should choose this job at Miele:At Miele, we are committed to talent, growth and sustainability. We are building a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone gets equal opportunities and can be the best version of themselves. Working from your talent makes you happy and gives you energy and desire to make a difference. Together, we develop innovative solutions that help the company succeed and make life easier for many households.We offer you:A permanent contract.A competitive salary based on your experience and skills.Flexible working hours, combined with remote working (2 days/week), to help you strike a good balance between work and leisure time.Work location: HQ Le Blanc Mesnil, and the tools you need to work to the best of your ability.A strong brand and a stable family business that attaches great importance to customer satisfaction.The Accounting Manager we are looking for:Proven knowledge of accounting, tax and legal matters in an international context.Education in finance and accounting, preferably CFA, CPA, FA or equivalent.5+ years of leadership experience and excellent people management skills.Strong business acumen and a commercial mindset.Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly and effectively.Experience working in a multinational, multi-location and multilingual environment.Comfortable operating within a matrix organization with diverse stakeholders.Excellent command of English and French (both written and spoken at C1-level).Professional, meticulous and collaborative communication style.Would you like to join us on a quest for "Immer Besser" and further develop your career? Then apply now!

jobs.occupation: Visual Controls and Machine Vision Expert (x|f|m) (Ingenieur/in - Biotechnologie)
jobs.description: Join our Automation team as a Visual Controls and Machine Vision Expert (x|f|m) and implement the strategy for visual inspection and control technologies in line with our Vision Technology Roadmaps. Integrate the latest technologies into manufacturing for inline visual inspection and automation, and support object detection and the integration of machine vision systems. This is how you help our teams focus on what matters most: better health for more people. The position is based in Aubagne (France), or alternatively in Goettingen (Germany), with the possibility of working remotely several days a week. You will join a team of 30 dedicated colleagues who look forward to shaping the future together with you.Grow With Us – Your Responsibilities- Implement the strategy for your technology area in line with the technology and automation roadmaps, and contribute to their further development- Lead technical projects to introduce vision systems and conduct feasibility studies. Assess processes, systems and equipment to optimize the use of visual inspection solutions- Manage and implement vision control systems for inline quality inspection, as well as machine vision systems for automated applications in physical AI and robotics- Take technical responsibility for automated visual inspections and further develop the use of vision control systems- Support technical discussions with key stakeholders, manufacturers and customers- Challenge existing visual inspection practices and establish best practices- Participate, where required, in non-conformance investigations, root cause analyses and quality risk assessments related to visual inspection- Provide your technical expertise for process validation and qualification activitiesWhat Will Convince Us- Technical master’s degree in vision technology, engineering or a related field- Several years of professional experience with vision control systems, along with experience using relevant camera technology and computer vision systems for feature and object detection- Proven expertise and achievements in at least one of the following technology areas: inline visual quality inspection or vision control systems in automation or robotics- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to approach complex challenges from new perspectives, combined with analytical thinking and a structured, solution-oriented working style- Strong teamwork skills and the ability to foster open communication, set clear expectations and promote a culture of learning and innovation- Fluent English; Willingness to travel internationallyWhat We OfferAs a growing global life science company, stock listed on the MDAX and TecDAX, Sartorius offers a wide range of Benefits:- Personal and Professional Development: Mentoring, leadership programs, Talent Talks, internal seminar offerings , coaching for managers- Work Life Balance: Remote options, flextime, flexible work schedules, sabbaticals, Workation- Attractive Compensation: Vacation and holiday bonuses including pension benefits with a 35 hr. week, 30 vacation days- Large, Modern Campus: Open office spaces, terraces, company restaurant with vegetarian and vegan options, cozy Italian bistro with ice cream sales, fitness studio and daycare center- Welcoming Culture: Mutual support, teamspirit and international collaboration; communities on numerous topics, such as coaching, agile working and business women network- This position is filled within the Sartorius Stedim Biotech GmbHWe promote diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from people of all nationalities, genders, sexual orientations, religions, age groups, disabilities, and cultural backgrounds.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
